purpose: Persistent order queue for the autonomous execution loop (scripts/autonomous-loop.ts). A 'business order' is one short natural-language request (e.g. 'Build a premium site for an artisan bakery in Sibiu'). The loop pulls the oldest PENDING order, runs the full pipeline (runJobFull: evidence -> strategy -> design -> content -> build -> QA -> repair -> deploy), records the runId + decision, and moves on. This file is the resume point: a fresh process reads it on boot and continues exactly where the previous one left off, so a killed session never loses a queued order. Same shape as docs/WORK_QUEUE.json's taskSchema.

orderSchema.order: the customer's request, in words (1-2 sentences, <=2000 chars)
orderSchema.runId: slug the loop assigned, maps to output/<runId>/
orderSchema.maxIter: integer 1..20, bounds the QA loop inside runJobFull
orderSchema.budgetTier: tier0|tier1|tier2|tier3 — how much a run may spend
orderSchema.finalOutput: local site path or live URL, or null
orderSchema.error: short machine-readable reason when status is FAILED
